places.name: Cathedral of Brasília (Oscar Niemeyer)
places.ai_summary: A masterpiece of modern architecture designed by Oscar Niemeyer, the Cathedral of Brasília features stunning stained glass windows and a unique hyperboloid structure.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during special events.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the underground chapel and the angel sculptures suspended from the ceiling.
